claims.claim: Microsoft Research open-sourced Agensh, a multi-agent harness that scaled from 1 to 1,024 agents on ProgramBench.
claims.episode_span: Microsoft Research open-sourced Agensh, a multi-agent harness with no central orchestrator. Every worker picks its own sub-task, shares findings, and merges code into a common Git repo while running the same five-step loop of gather, claim, act, verify, and merge. On ProgramBench the setup scaled from 1 agent to 1,024 agents across 16 nodes.
claims.supporting_quote: On ProgramBench, the team scaled the setup from 1 agent to 1,024 agents.

claims.supporting_quote: at a history length of 128k tokens, memt-1.0-nano delivers roughly 1.86x end-to-end inference speedup and a 66x reduction in persistent storage compared to a full-context kv cache setup.
